independent_c_bootstrap.scope: Before the final rejection of malformed object-wrapped zero-field enum variants; performance reports identify this toolchain.

validation.settings_example: Native/web, default/release; exact expected output in all four modes

behavior: Typed to_json writes directly, without to_text or an intermediate Json tree
Exact signed/unsigned 64-bit integers, finite f32/f64 round trips and negative zero
Records, nested/fixed arrays, tuples, vectors/mat4, maps, optionals, enums and unions
Typed enum payloads read back from the documented JSON object/array representation
json_value uses the same schema but intentionally retains Json.number f64 precision
